status_semantics.PRESERVED_CONNECTED: The native implementation is present and reachable through the stated lifecycle. This status alone is not current-law qualification.
status_semantics.CURRENT_LAW_QUALIFIED: The executed consumer has a discriminating equation-level and populated-state numerical correspondence at the declared scope.
status_semantics.INCOMPLETE: Required physical evidence, selection, or execution remains unavailable; no fallback law is authorized.

equation_correspondence.recovery: N_m(t+dt)=N_m(t) exp(-k_m dt); N_r(t+dt)=N_r(t) exp(-k_r dt)

enabled_consumers.physical_interpretation: Wake content is retained as signed state and may contribute through the separately configured wake mechanics. The wake evolution step does not invent a new applied opening drive; with the current cancellation-stable signed rate its zero-drive exchange and glide rates are exactly zero. Explicit recovery remains active when configured.
